user_decision.question: Dropping wordOf's unused [F.IsRegular] binder, as authorized in cycle 10, did not clear the C16 env_linter FAIL -- it relocated it to truthAt_iff_intTruth_of_boxFree, whose binder turns out to have been load-bearing only as a conduit supplying wordOf's instance argument. Clearing C16 therefore requires amending a SECOND verbatim-pinned Challenge statement, which the cycle-10 answer did not cover and explicitly asserted would not be needed. How should Phase 4 proceed?

options.label: Amend truthAt_iff_intTruth_of_boxFree too
options.detail: Apply the same authorized shape one declaration over: drop [F.IsRegular] from the plan's ## Lean Challenge Statements block and from the declaration at ZTimeSubstitutionBridge.lean:102, in one change. Measured consequences: the cascade terminates there (validZTime_of_boxFree_intTruth binds its instance tactic-locally from ValidInt's own quantifier, so the linter cannot reach it); the theorem has zero references outside its own file, so no external statement changes; the amendment is strictly generalizing and leaves the name, the C14 pin, the measured [propext] profile and the docs/theorem-index.md row untouched; the isBoxFree hypothesis, the only one this module declares load-bearing, is unaffected. This clears C16 and closes Phase 4.

options.label: Stop at wordOf; accept the C16 red
options.detail: Keep the landed wordOf amendment, leave truthAt_iff_intTruth_of_boxFree's signature as recorded, and close Phase 4 as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with the C16 finding recorded as a known, named exclusion against this task's own file. Cost: CI's lake lint will see the finding, and a later task inherits it.

options.label: Revert both; take the allowlist route
options.detail: Restore wordOf's original pinned signature and suppress the finding in source instead -- an @[nolint unusedArguments] attribute plus a scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt entry. Both pinned statements then stand exactly as recorded. Cost: Phase 3 already ruled this inadmissible under that allowlist's own ADMISSION BAR, which demands a reason why THIS declaration cannot conform and directs 'fix the declaration instead' when it can -- and both declarations can conform. Choosing this overrides that bar knowingly.

user_decision.recommendation: Amend truthAt_iff_intTruth_of_boxFree too -- it is the same decided principle applied to the adjacent declaration, the cascade bound is measured rather than assumed, and it is the only route that clears C16 without overriding a standing admission bar.
